fact_text: The founder started the brand in 2020 with about PKR 15,000 of savings, buying inventory from several vendors in small lots and selling it online.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From PKR 15,000 to an Award-Winning Fashion Brand – Maaz Yaqoob’s Inspiring Journey | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-13)

fact_text: The brand first sold through e-commerce channels including Daraz, Shopify, Facebook and Instagram, and only later opened a retail store after COVID-19.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From PKR 15,000 to an Award-Winning Fashion Brand – Maaz Yaqoob’s Inspiring Journey | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-13)

fact_text: The founder's method was to buy small inventory lots, put them on sale, and reorder as each lot sold out, which kept capital tied up only in stock that was moving.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From PKR 15,000 to an Award-Winning Fashion Brand – Maaz Yaqoob’s Inspiring Journey | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-13)

fact_text: The brand's product range covers t-shirts, polo shirts, casual shirts, shorts, trousers and cargo trousers, with fabrics including single jersey, lycra jersey, terry and jacquard.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From PKR 15,000 to an Award-Winning Fashion Brand – Maaz Yaqoob’s Inspiring Journey | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-13)

fact_text: The brand said it supplies clothing across almost all of Pakistan and has started selling in the Middle East, including Dubai, Saudi Arabia and Qatar.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From PKR 15,000 to an Award-Winning Fashion Brand – Maaz Yaqoob’s Inspiring Journey | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-13)

fact_text: The founder said the brand's margin was compressed from 15 to 20 percent to about 5 to 6 percent as competition in the market increased.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From PKR 15,000 to an Award-Winning Fashion Brand – Maaz Yaqoob’s Inspiring Journey | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-13)

fact_text: The brand's price range runs from about PKR 180 for basic items up to about PKR 5,000 for higher-quality or imported-fabric garments.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From PKR 15,000 to an Award-Winning Fashion Brand – Maaz Yaqoob’s Inspiring Journey | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-13)

fact_text: The founder said Pakistani garment exporters are losing out to lower-cost competitors such as Bangladesh, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, China and Turkey, which export at much lower prices.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From PKR 15,000 to an Award-Winning Fashion Brand – Maaz Yaqoob’s Inspiring Journey | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-13)

fact_text: The founder said Pakistan's energy crisis and sharply higher electricity bills have made garment makers uncompetitive against Bangladesh, Indonesia and Malaysia.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From PKR 15,000 to an Award-Winning Fashion Brand – Maaz Yaqoob’s Inspiring Journey | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-13)

fact_text: To manage the energy cost burden the brand installed solar power, which the founder said helps but does not fully close the competitiveness gap.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From PKR 15,000 to an Award-Winning Fashion Brand – Maaz Yaqoob’s Inspiring Journey | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-13)

fact_text: The founder described apparel demand as a basic necessity, so the market for clothing is large and keeps growing rather than shrinking.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From PKR 15,000 to an Award-Winning Fashion Brand – Maaz Yaqoob’s Inspiring Journey | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-13)

fact_text: The founder said new players can still enter the apparel market because it is large, but competition has grown and margins have been squeezed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From PKR 15,000 to an Award-Winning Fashion Brand – Maaz Yaqoob’s Inspiring Journey | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-13)

fact_text: The founder said the online sales market has become saturated, with more sellers entering, including many who sell online courses as a side business.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From PKR 15,000 to an Award-Winning Fashion Brand – Maaz Yaqoob’s Inspiring Journey | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-13)

fact_text: The founder's view was that cutting prices to hold share is not a solution, so the brand must differentiate to stay competitive.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'From PKR 15,000 to an Award-Winning Fashion Brand – Maaz Yaqoob’s Inspiring Journey | Scaled' (YouTube, 2025-05-13)
